instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all content is explored using the smooth 'a schede tab' architecture. All tab transitions should use Framer Motion for clean horizontal fade-slides. Ensure the price comparison widget prominently displays how much money guests save by booking directly instead of Airbnb/Booking. Preserve all Stripe integration endpoints, test IDs, and multilingual support (IT, EN, DE, ES).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility: Ensure high contrast on text overlays using subtle dark gradient scrims over background photos.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.javascript_note: The codebase uses React .jsx and .js files. Ensure all guidelines reference .js/.jsx conventions.
